headline: A new Lion says he joined a year ago, and a Lion from the Philippines welcomes him in.
story: A café table at the convention. Atdhe sits with a Lion from the Philippines in her purple club vest. She says where she is from. Atdhe says he became a Lion almost a year ago. She answers: “Oh, welcome to the Lions.” He tells her he is on a mission to make more friends. She waves goodbye.
Honest flag: this is very thin. She says only two short lines. Most words are Atdhe's. The cut works only as a tiny welcome moment. Keep it short and sweet.

Make “welcome to the Lions” the centre of the cut. Hold her smile after it.
Keep it near 20 s. Don't stretch it.
dont: Don't caption “I became a Lion almost a year ago” as her line. Atdhe says it (the frames show him talking).
Don't use the “365 friends” line. The South Africa cut ends on Atdhe's new-friend moment; one per batch.
Don't borrow the Icee Leo clip (IMG_7828). It has its own item, so it would repeat.
No name super. The transcript name “Ate” is not verified.
No logo or title at 0:00. 9:16 only.
